title.zh: Industry First: TradFi Perp Options, a new way to trade Stock Perpetuals.

current_state.zh: Bybit announced an industry-first launch of TradFi perpetual options on stock perpetuals such as SPCX and NVDA, offering 24/7 USDT-settled trading with fractional lots starting September 17, 2026.
